name: Rockwall County, TX
findings: Rockwall County has 311 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 94 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rockwall County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 36 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
